title: Foreign Area Staff Non-Commissioned Officer-South Asia (SgtMaj/ MGySgt to SSgt) FMOS, DC PP&O
raw_text:
7. MOS 8236, Foreign Area Staff Non-Commissioned Officer-South Asia (SgtMaj/
MGySgt to SSgt) FMOS, DC PP&O

    a. Summary. Foreign Area Staff Non-Commissioned Officers (FAS) provide
language skills, regional expertise and cultural capabilities (LREC) to MAGTF
commanders throughout the phases of military operations and across the range
of military operations to achieve US government objectives. FAS’s will apply
LREC to the Marine Corps Planning Process, Security Cooperation and combined
exercise planning, and serve as LREC trainers for operational force units
members of Forward Command Elements, and inter-organizational liaisons.
FAS’s will acquire Core Plus skills in Civil Affairs and Information
Operations through skill progression and enhancement training as available/
required. FAS’s are proficient in their PMOS. This MOS may be assigned only
as a FMOS and is available to ground and aviation Marines.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Meet prerequisites prescribed in reference (cn).

            (2) Regional and Culture Studies Program (RCSP) complete in grade.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Security requirement: TS/SCI security clearance eligibility
based on a tier 5 background investigation.

            (2) Completion of (a) or (b) below:

            (a) Completion of prescribed study track curriculum in accordance
with reference (cn).

                (b) Completion of the following:

                    1.     Associates degree.

                    2.     Six months of foreign immersion or regional experience.

                3. Must demonstrate intermediate level foreign language
proficiency by scoring annually a minimum of level 1+ in two of the tested
modalities of the defense language proficiency test (DLPT) or oral
proficiency interview (OPI).

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
references Security Cooperation/Language, Regional Expertise, and Culture
Training and Readiness Manual (ci), and International Affairs Program MCO
(cn).

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Political Scientist 19-3094.

       f.   Related Military Skill.     None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
